title: Money Electric: The Bitcoin Mystery
description: Documentary exploring the origins of cryptocurrency Bitcoin and the identity of its pseudonymous creator Satoshi Nakamoto.

title: After the Bite
description: Documentary investigating the surge in great white sharks patrolling Cape Cod's shallow waters and the fallout from one young man's death.

title: My Icon: Nasser Hussain
description: The former England cricket captain and Sky Sports pundit discusses the individuals that have inspired him during his life and career.

title: Luca: Seeing Red
description: Chris Harris travels to Italy to spends a week with Italian businessman Luca di Montezemolo, the former chairman of Ferrari.

title: Villeneuve Pironi: Racing's Untold Tragedy
description: The relationship between F1 drivers Gilles Villeneuve and Didier Pironi, team-mates whose friendship was torn apart after a controversial ending to the 1982 San Marino Grand Prix.

title: Williams & Mansell: Red 5
description: Documentary charting the rise of Nigel Mansell, the Williams F1 racing team and how they came together to fight for the Formula 1 World Drivers' Championship.

title: My Icon: Martin Offiah
description: The former rugby league superstar discusses the individuals that have inspired him in his life and career.

title: The Man Who Bought Cricket
description: The story of Allen Stanford's plan to revolutionise the game of cricket, which fell apart when he was exposed as a financial fraudster.

title: The Man Who Bought Cricket
description: Now bankrupt, Allen Stanford spies a new opportunity in Montserrat. However, his new venture attracts the attention of US and UK law enforcement agencies.

title: The Man Who Bought Cricket
description: Allen Stanford moves his operation to Antigua where he discovers the power of cricket in the Caribbean.

title: The Battle for Blackpool
description: The story of how a clan of fiercely loyal Blackpool FC fans staged the largest football boycott in British history and managed to win their club back.

title: QPR: The Four Year Plan
description: An insight into the running of Queens Park Rangers football club, as cameras were given unprecedented access to the boardroom and the first team. In 2007, the club was facing relegation from the Championship as well as financial ruin, before being bought by F1 supremo Bernie Ecclestone and Italian businessman Flavio Briatore. Soon after, they were joined on the board by Indian steel magnate Lakshmi Mittal, and together the new owners promised a return to glory for the club and its supporters.

title: King of Lies: Football's Greatest Con
description: A look at fraudster Russell King's takeover of Notts County, which set in motion a chain of events that exposed a web of deception at the heart of the project, with lasting personal and financial consequences for those involved.

title: Brazil 2002
description: Documentary following the Brazilian national team through the 2002 World Cup, which culminated in the country's fifth victory in the tournament.

title: Hitsville: The Making of Motown
description: Rare performances, interviews and rarely seen footage come together to paint a picture of the history and origins of the Motown record label.

title: Discovering: Jon Voight
description: A look at the life and career of the actor, who starred in Midnight Cowboy, Deliverance and Runaway Train and won an Academy Award for his role in 1978 film Coming Home.

title: Discovering: Dustin Hoffman
description: A look at the life and career of the actor, who starred in The Graduate, Midnight Cowboy and Tootsie and won Academy Awards for his roles in Kramer vs Kramer and Rain Man.

title: Bardot
description: A look at the life and career of actress Brigitte Bardot, examining the hardships, trials and struggles she faced as well as her work and legacy.

title: Premier League 360 - Big Sam's Bolton
description: A look at Sam Allardyce's Bolton Wanderers team, with the manager using pioneering sports science and data analysis to take the club on an unforgettable journey.

title: The Battle for Blackpool
description: The story of how a clan of fiercely loyal Blackpool FC fans staged the largest football boycott in British history and managed to win their club back.

title: I Am Steve McQueen
description: The life and career of the American actor, who starred in The Thomas Crown Affair, The Getaway, Papillon, The Magnificent Seven, The Great Escape and The Towering Inferno. Featuring contributions by his son Chad, grandson Steven and granddaughter Molly, as well as ex-wives Neile Adams McQueen and Ali MacGraw and widow Barbara Minty McQueen.

title: I'm Carl Lewis!
description: A profile of the former athlete, who was a nine-time Olympic gold medalist and fought to revolutionise his sport and inspire change on and off the field.

title: Lancaster
description: The story of the bomber synonymous with the Dambusters, the night raids against Germany and the brave men and women who made them possible.

title: Spitfire
description: The story of the British single-seat fighter plane the Supermarine Spitfire, designed by RJ Mitchell and famous for its role in the Battle of Britain. Archive footage, new film of the aircraft in flight and interviews with the last surviving veterans who flew the plane in combat combine to tell its story.

title: The Alabama Solution
description: Documentary film about the prison system in Alabama told from the perspective of incarcerated inmates, who reveal endemic abuse of power and a cover-up.

title: Bowling for Columbine
description: Michael Moore's Oscar-winning documentary exploring America's love affair with firearms. Going beyond public opinion, the film-maker examines corporate and political influence, visiting a bank where weapons are given to customers, as well as talking to Charlton Heston, one of the most famous proponents of every American's right to bear arms.
